title: Website Publisher v0.4 → RasenFalcon v0.4.2 offline candidate staging
summary: Website Publisher v0.4 is a Library candidate with browser editor, export and native NoSQLServer v0.90 append-only snapshots. A separate RasenFalcon v0.4.2 GitHub submission adds stage-publisher for export/0.1 or candidate native-record/0.2. The imported editorial snapshot is a separate unreviewed candidate; it cannot authorize CMS or Wire release.
invariants: The browser editor does not own authentication, device identity, public site publication, Wire release or privileged NoSQLServer authority.
stage-publisher accepts only site rasenfalcon.com, authority CANDIDATE_ONLY, exact configured nine page slugs, valid JSON with unique keys, bounded size and owned editorial fields.
Native-record/0.2 revision from NoSQLServer is recorded as unverified: native_revision_verified is false; no signature, identity, review or publication authority follows from storage.
Stage is created separately and atomically in an unused target; never overwrite the source checkout, the user's destination or an existing site preview.
Every staged page is candidate, even if the publisher claimed approved; stage manifest has authority NONE, state CANDIDATE_UNREVIEWED, no CMS/Wire receipts and production_build_allowed false.
All rendered previews remain noindex,nofollow; publication stays denied even for forged local approval records.
The v0.4 Publisher browser-to-native handoff is explicitly offline; a native NoSQLServer v0.90 test is not a live multi-writer CMS service or production RexxOS qualification.
Do not conflate the Publisher's v0.4 distribution, the site builder's v0.4.2 source branch and publisher Gopher sphere v0.2; they are separately owned artifacts.
RasenFalcon v0.4.2 branch declares 18 website tests; no independent execution was recorded here. Rasen Falcon MCP test request REQ-00000943 awaits named operator approval.

provenance.claim: Library v0.4 editorial publisher implementation and declared native qualification limits.
Independent Publisher continuity documenting offline RasenFalcon v0.2 staging.
